crossRefs.note: Pharisees came to him, testing him, and saying, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any reason?”
They asked him, “Why then did Moses command us to give her a certificate of divorce, and divorce her?”
When a man takes a wife and marries her, then it shall be, if she finds no favor in his eyes because he has found some…
“They say, ‘If a man puts away his wife, and she goes from him, and becomes another man’s, should he return to her…
Pharisees came to him testing him, and asked him, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife?”

translations.web: “It was also said, ‘Whoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorce,’
translations.bsb: It has also been said, ‘Whoever divorces his wife must give her a certificate of divorce.’
translations.kjv: It hath been said, Whosoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorcement:
translations.asv: It was said also, Whosoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorcement:
